veg.n: Bowling alley mushroom and haloumi burgers
veg.make_ahead: Burger sauce up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Blanch the chips in the neutral oil at 140C for 5 minutes and drain.
Cool the chips for 15 minutes.
Fry the chips again at 185C until crisp and season with the salt.

Brush the mushrooms with the olive oil and cook on a hot griddle, pressing flat with a heavy pan, for 3 minutes a side. Griddle the haloumi slabs alongside for 2 minutes a side until golden, then melt the cheese over the mushrooms.
Toast the buns, mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and mustard for the sauce, and fill each bun with a mushroom, a slab of haloumi, onion, pickles and sauce. Serve the chips alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days ahead, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince with 1 diced onion in the oil in a large pan.
Add the chilli powder, cumin, tomatoes, kidney beans and water and simmer 20 minutes until thick.
Heat the vegetarian franks in barely simmering water for 3 minutes, then sear on a hot griddle until blistered.
Toast the hot dog buns.
Fill each bun with a frank and a spoon of chilli, then top with the cheddar, the rest of the diced raw onion and mustard.
Heat the oven to its highest setting with a pizza steel or heavy tray inside.
Toss the mushrooms with the olive oil, smoked paprika and chilli flakes.
Top the mini bases with a little of the crushed tomatoes and mozzarella and bake for the reveal.
Stretch the dough as thin as you can and spread with the rest of the crushed tomatoes.
Scatter over the remaining mozzarella and the spiced mushrooms.
Bake on the hot steel at maximum heat until the crust blisters and the cheese bubbles.

veg.n: Deep dish pizza with fennel mushroom crumble
veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Heat the oven to 220C. Press the dough mixed with the butter into a deep greased tin.
Simmer the crushed tomatoes with the crushed garlic.
Fry the mushrooms in the olive oil with the fennel seeds and chilli flakes over high heat until dry and well browned.
Layer the mozzarella, then the mushroom crumble, then the tomato.
Finish with the parmesan and bake at 220C.
Rest before slicing.

veg.n: Sweet potato and black bean mole with rice and tortillas
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Toast the chillies in a dry pan and soak in hot water.
Blend the drained chillies with the almonds, garlic, cinnamon and stock.
Simmer the sauce and melt in the chocolate. Season with the salt.
Add the sweet potato and black beans, cover and simmer until the sweet potato is tender.
Cook the rice, warm the tortillas and serve with the mole.

veg.make_ahead: Stuffing up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Halve the pumpkin lengthways, scoop out the seeds and a little flesh to make a hollow, and chop the scooped flesh.
Fry the onion, sage and chopped pumpkin flesh in the butter until soft.
Mix with the torn sourdough, egg and salt for a stuffing.
Pack the stuffing into both halves, press the pumpkin back together and tie with kitchen string.
Rub the pumpkin and potatoes with the oil and roast at 180C, potatoes around the pumpkin, until a skewer slides easily into the pumpkin.
Rest the pumpkin for 10 minutes, then cut into thick slices.
Cook the sprouts and toss with the sprout butter.

veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Cut each cauliflower through the stem into 2 thick chops and rub with the rosemary, garlic, salt and oil.
Sear the chops in a hot ovenproof pan for 3 minutes a side, then roast until tender.
Boil the potatoes and mash with 50g of the butter.
Cook the peas.
Melt the remaining butter in the cauliflower pan, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce and simmer into a gravy.

veg.n: Grace's arroz con garbanzos y hongos
veg.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat with a splash of stock

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in a little oil in a wide lidded pan until golden, then set aside.
Fry the onion, capsicum, garlic and coriander in the same pan until soft.
Stir in the annatto, rice, chickpeas, olives, capers and stock and bring to a simmer.
Sit the mushrooms on top, cover and cook on low until the rice is tender.
Rest, covered, before serving.

veg.n: King oyster mushrooms à la Gusteau

steps.text: Slice the mushrooms lengthways 2cm thick, score both sides in a crosshatch and season with salt.
Dust with the flour and pan-fry in 30g of the butter for 4 minutes a side until deep golden.
Deglaze the pan with the stock and lemon juice, reduce by half, then swirl in the remaining 20g cold butter and spoon the sauce over the mushrooms.

veg.make_ahead: Gravy up to 2 days ahead, reheat gently

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Bring the water and salt to the boil, trim the cauliflower leaves and boil it whole for 6 minutes, then drain and dry.
Toss the potatoes and pumpkin with the oil on a roasting tray.
Mash 40g of the butter with the paprika and garlic and rub all over the cauliflower.
Roast the cauliflower on the tray with the potato and pumpkin until deep golden and tender to a skewer.
Rest the cauliflower, covered. Bake the stuffing mix as the packet says.
Melt the remaining butter in a pan, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce and simmer into a gravy. Cut the cauliflower into wedges and serve with everything.

veg.make_ahead: Sauce best made just before serving

steps.text: Reduce the vinegar with half the tarragon and the chopped shallot until almost dry. Cut and dry the chips.
Fry the chips in the vegetable oil at 140C, then drain.
Whisk the yolks with the strained reduction over low heat until thick, then drizzle in the warm butter and stir through the rest of the tarragon, chopped.
Brush the mushrooms with the olive oil and garlic, season with salt and pepper and sear in a hot heavy pan, pressed under a weight, for 5 minutes a side until tender.
Fry the chips again until crisp and serve with the mushrooms and sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Chop the onions, potatoes and carrots.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Soften the onions, stir in the tomato paste and flour, then add the stock, soy sauce, potatoes, carrots and mushrooms.
Cover and simmer until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the lentils and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes, then ladle into bowls with thick white bread.

veg.n: Tarragon cream mushrooms with potato gratin
veg.make_ahead: Gratin can be made 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: mixed mushrooms, king oyster and swiss brown, thickly sliced

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin, layer with 300ml of the cream, the crushed garlic and the salt and bake at 160C.
Pan-roast the mushrooms in the butter and oil in batches until deep golden.
Add the wine to the pan and bubble for 2 minutes, then the Dijon, chopped tarragon and remaining cream, and simmer.
Steam the beans.
Serve together.

veg_af.n: Tarragon cream mushrooms with potato gratin
veg_af.make_ahead: Gratin can be made 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: mixed mushrooms, king oyster and swiss brown, thickly sliced

steps.text: Slice the potatoes thin, layer with 300ml of the cream, the crushed garlic and the salt and bake at 160C.
Pan-roast the mushrooms in the butter and oil in batches until deep golden.
Add the stock and verjuice to the pan and bubble for 2 minutes, then the Dijon, chopped tarragon and remaining cream, and simmer.
Steam the beans.
Serve together.

veg.make_ahead: Nut roast mix up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Fry the onion, garlic and mushrooms in the olive oil until dry.
Mix with the nuts, lentils, breadcrumbs, cheddar, thyme, 1 tbsp of the soy sauce, 2 of the eggs, salt and pepper, and press into a lined loaf tin.
Whisk the remaining 3 eggs, 140g of the flour and the milk into a smooth batter and leave to rest.
Bake the nut roast until firm and browned on top.
Rest the roast under foil. Raise the oven to 220C, heat the oiled tins until smoking, pour in the batter and bake the puddings until risen and golden.
Melt the butter, stir in the remaining flour, then whisk in the stock and remaining soy sauce and simmer until slightly thickened. Slice the roast and serve.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 4 hours ahead

ingredients.item: oyster and king oyster mushrooms, torn into large pieces

steps.text: Mix the garlic, oregano, salt, vinegar and oil, toss through the mushrooms and leave to marinate for 30 minutes.
Heat the oven to 230C and spread the mushrooms over two lined trays.
Roast the mushrooms, turning once, until the edges are dark and crisp.
Meanwhile cook the rice with the drained pigeon peas, stock and onion until tender, and serve with the mushrooms piled on top.

veg.make_ahead: Adobo up to 2 days ahead, fry the rice fresh

steps.text: Cook the rice and spread it on a tray to cool.
Crush the garlic. Pat the tofu dry and cut into large cubes.
Brown the tofu in 2 tbsp of the oil until golden on all sides.
Add two thirds of the garlic, the vinegar, soy sauce, bay leaves, peppercorns and water, and simmer uncovered, turning gently, until the sauce is sticky.
Fry the cooled rice with the rest of the garlic in the remaining oil until crisp in spots.
Fry the eggs and serve the adobo over the rice with an egg on top.

veg.make_ahead: Spice rub up to 1 week ahead

steps.text: Brush the mushrooms with the oil and rub with the salt, pepper, garlic powder and paprika.
Grill over high heat, pressing down and turning, until charred outside and tender inside.
Rest for 3 minutes, then slice as thin as you can.
Pile onto the rolls with raw onion and horseradish sauce.

veg.n: Van Pelt's juniper beetroot and redcurrant
veg.make_ahead: Beetroot can be roasted up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Wrap the beetroot in foil with half the thyme and the oil and roast at 200C until tender.
Meanwhile peel and boil the parsnips and potatoes until soft.
Crush the juniper with the pepper and the remaining thyme leaves.
Rub the skins off the beetroot, halve, press the cut sides into the juniper mix and sear in 20g of the butter until crusted.
Add the stock and redcurrant jelly to the pan and reduce until glossy, then whisk in another 20g of the butter.
Mash the vegetables with the remaining butter and serve with the beetroot, crumbled goat's cheese and sauce.

veg.n: Frank Vitale's linguine with oyster mushrooms

steps.text: Tear the mushrooms into strips and slice the garlic.
Fry the mushrooms in half the olive oil over high heat until golden at the edges.
Add the garlic and chilli for 1 minute, then the wine, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Cook the linguine 1 minute short, finish it in the pan with a splash of pasta water, then toss with the lemon, parsley and more olive oil.

veg_af.n: Frank Vitale's linguine with oyster mushrooms

steps.text: Tear the mushrooms into strips and slice the garlic.
Fry the mushrooms in half the olive oil over high heat until golden at the edges.
Add the garlic and chilli for 1 minute, then the stock, and simmer for 3 minutes.
Cook the linguine 1 minute short, finish it in the pan with a splash of pasta water, then toss with the lemon, parsley and more olive oil.
Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Peel the celeriac, cut into 4 slices about 3cm thick and season with salt.
Sear in the oil in a hot pan, then lower the heat, add the butter, crushed garlic and thyme, and baste, turning, until tender all the way through.
Rest for 3 minutes.
Wilt the spinach with the cream and serve alongside the steaks and potatoes.
Boil the potatoes until tender and crush with 30g of the butter.
Pat the tofu dry, cut into 4 thick slabs, season with the salt and dust with the cornflour.
Fry the tofu in the oil over medium-high heat for 4 minutes a side until crisp.
Melt the remaining butter with the lemon juice and dill and spoon over.
Steam the beans.

veg.n: Mayor's roast cauliflower and mint sauce

steps.text: Cut the potatoes and pumpkin, toss with half the oil and roast at 200C.
Cut the cauliflower into 8 wedges and toss with the remaining oil, rosemary leaves and salt.
Roast the cauliflower alongside the vegetables until everything is golden and charred at the edges.
Cook the peas.
Mix chopped mint with the vinegar, sugar and hot water for the mint sauce. Serve the cauliflower with the feta crumbled over.

veg.n: State dinner spinach and ricotta parcels
veg.make_ahead: Make the filling up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Wilt the spinach, squeeze dry and mix with the ricotta, crumbled feta, egg and the zest of 1 lemon.
Slice the potatoes, layer in a dish with the cream, crushed garlic and seasoning, and bake at 200C.
Melt 50g of the butter. Brush 2 filo sheets at a time, fold into a square, add a quarter of the filling and wrap into a parcel.
Bake the parcels on a tray alongside the gratin until crisp and golden.
Melt the remaining butter, whisk in the lemon juice and spoon over the parcels.

veg.make_ahead: Garlic butter up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into fries.
Fry twice in the oil until crisp.
Mix the butter with the garlic and parsley. Halve the mushrooms lengthways, score the cut sides and season with the salt.
Grill the mushrooms cut side down, then turn, brush with the garlic parsley butter and grill until tender.
Serve with the fries and lemon wedges.

veg.n: Creamy mushroom, cannellini and rice casserole

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches and set aside.
Soften the onion in the same pan, then stir in the rice, stock, cream, thyme, beans and mushrooms.
Pour into a baking dish and cover.
Bake at 180C for 45 minutes.
Uncover, scatter over the parmesan and bake 10 minutes more.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, reheat covered

ingredients.item: tins young green jackfruit in brine (565g each), drained

steps.text: Cut the hard cores off the jackfruit and shred the rest with two forks.
Fry in the oil with the paprika and salt for 5 minutes, add the stock, cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Spread on a tray and roast at 200C until the edges catch.
Simmer the vinegar with the brown sugar and chilli flakes.
Toss the jackfruit through most of the sauce. Shred the cabbage for a slaw and dress it with a splash of the sauce.
Pile the jackfruit into the buns with the slaw.

veg.make_ahead: Patties up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Mash the beans with the breadcrumbs, egg, paprika, cumin and salt and shape into 8 thin patties. Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and a chopped pickle for the sauce.
Fry the patties in the oil on a hot griddle for 3 minutes, flip, top with cheese and cook 3 minutes more.
Toast the buns. Stack 2 patties per bun with sauce, sliced pickles and diced onion.
Slice the mushrooms and onion.
Sear half the mushrooms fast in the oil until browned and set aside.
Cook the rest of the mushrooms and the onion in 30g of the butter, add the paprika, then the brandy, and let it bubble away.
Add the stock and soy sauce and simmer.
Cook the noodles and toss with the remaining butter.
Stir in the sour cream off the heat and return the seared mushrooms.
Slice the mushrooms and onion.
Sear half the mushrooms fast in the oil until browned and set aside.
Cook the rest of the mushrooms and the onion in 30g of the butter, add the paprika, then the extra stock and lemon juice, and let it bubble away.
Add the stock and soy sauce and simmer.
Cook the noodles and toss with the remaining butter.
Stir in the sour cream off the heat and return the seared mushrooms.

veg.n: Lobster-style rolls with hearts of palm
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled

ingredients.item: tins hearts of palm (400g each), drained

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips.
Fry the chips in the oil once at a lower heat, then again hot until crisp.
Chop the hearts of palm into chunks and fold with the mayonnaise, lemon juice, diced celery, chives and paprika.
Butter and toast the split buns and fill.
Toss the tofu in 1 tbsp of the soy sauce, then the cornflour.
Cook the rice.
Fry the tofu in 3 tbsp of the oil until crisp and set aside.
Fry the chillies and Sichuan pepper in the remaining oil, then return the tofu and toss.
Add the vinegar, remaining soy, sugar and Shaoxing and toss until glossy.
Add the peanuts and spring onions and serve with the rice.
Toss the tofu in 1 tbsp of the soy sauce, then the cornflour.
Cook the rice.
Fry the tofu in 3 tbsp of the oil until crisp and set aside.
Fry the chillies and Sichuan pepper in the remaining oil, then return the tofu and toss.
Add the vinegar, remaining soy, sugar, stock and rice vinegar and toss until glossy.
Add the peanuts and spring onions and serve with the rice.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin, brown sugar, grated ginger and crushed garlic for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Pat the tofu dry, cut into 8 thick slabs and marinate in half the sauce for 30 minutes.
Brush the tofu with the oil and cook on a hot barbecue plate for 4 minutes a side, brushing with more sauce.
Grill the peeled pineapple slices 2 minutes a side.
Cook the rice.
Serve the tofu with the pineapple, rice, sesame seeds, sliced spring onion and sliced chilli in rice vinegar.

veg_af.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Simmer the soy, apple juice, extra rice vinegar, brown sugar, grated ginger and crushed garlic for 5 minutes until syrupy.
Pat the tofu dry, cut into 8 thick slabs and marinate in half the sauce for 30 minutes.
Brush the tofu with the oil and cook on a hot barbecue plate for 4 minutes a side, brushing with more sauce.
Grill the peeled pineapple slices 2 minutes a side.
Cook the rice.
Serve the tofu with the pineapple, rice, sesame seeds, sliced spring onion and sliced chilli in rice vinegar.
Fry the swiss brown mushrooms in the oil with the paprika until dark and crisp, then set aside.
Fry the oyster mushrooms in the butter until golden, add the wine, reduce by half and tip into a bowl.
Soften the onion, celery and potato in the same pot.
Add the stock, nori and milk and simmer until the potato is tender.
Stir in the cream, corn, oyster mushrooms and thyme and heat through. Serve topped with the crisp mushrooms.
Fry the swiss brown mushrooms in the oil with the paprika until dark and crisp, then set aside.
Fry the oyster mushrooms in the butter until golden, add the extra stock and lemon juice, reduce by half and tip into a bowl.
Soften the onion, celery and potato in the same pot.
Add the stock, nori and milk and simmer until the potato is tender.
Stir in the cream, corn, oyster mushrooms and thyme and heat through. Serve topped with the crisp mushrooms.

veg.make_ahead: Rissoles up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Roughly mash the lentils and mix with one grated onion, the carrot, egg, breadcrumbs, cheddar and 1 tbsp of the soy sauce.
Shape into eight rissoles and chill for 15 minutes.
Fry in 2 tbsp of the oil until browned on both sides, then set aside.
Fry the other onion, sliced, in the remaining oil, stir in the flour, then the stock and remaining soy sauce to make a gravy.
Return the rissoles and simmer gently in the gravy.
Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter, and cook the peas.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, reheats well

steps.text: Chop the vegetables.
Simmer the barley, carrots, leek and celery in the stock for 50 minutes.
Add the chickpeas and simmer 10 minutes more.
Stir through the parsley and lemon juice, season with salt and serve with the brown bread.

veg.n: Hotel club sandwich and shoestring fries (vegetarian)

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into shoestrings and fry once in the oil.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool in cold water, peel and slice.
Fry the smoked tofu in a little of the oil until crisp, then splash with the soy sauce. Toast the bread.
Layer the tofu, egg, lettuce, sliced tomato and mayonnaise across three slices each and cut into triangles.
Fry the fries a second time until crisp.

veg.n: Sulaco mess hall lentil and mushroom loaf
veg.make_ahead: Loaf up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat

steps.text: Heat the oven to 180C. Soak the breadcrumbs in 100ml of the milk. Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil until dry.
Mix with the lentils, walnuts, eggs, soy sauce, salt and pepper, and press into a loaf on a lined tray.
Glaze with the tomato sauce and bake until firm.
Meanwhile peel and chop the potatoes, boil until tender, then mash with the butter and the remaining warm milk.
Rest the loaf for 10 minutes, slice and serve with the mash.

veg.make_ahead: Loaf up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Roughly mash the lentils and mix with the onion, carrot, cheddar, breadcrumbs, eggs and salt.
Press into a lined loaf tin and spread with the tomato sauce.
Bake at 180C until firm and set.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with the butter and milk.
Rest the loaf for 10 minutes, then slice thickly and serve on the mash.

veg.n: Big Boy's spaghetti with mushroom and ricotta meatballs
veg.make_ahead: Sauce and meatballs up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Cook the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry and cool slightly.
Soak the bread in the milk, squeeze and mix with the mushrooms, ricotta, egg and half the parmesan. Roll into balls and chill for 15 minutes.
Brown the meatballs gently in the remaining oil.
Add the tomatoes and basil and simmer gently.
Cook the spaghetti.
Toss with the sauce and serve with the rest of the parmesan.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 4 hours ahead

steps.text: Slice the eggplants lengthways 2cm thick and toss with 4 crushed garlic cloves, the rosemary leaves, the juice of 1 lemon and 4 tbsp of the oil. Leave for 1 hour.
Grill the eggplant over high heat until charred and soft.
Grill the haloumi 2 minutes a side.
Chop the parsley, capers, remaining garlic and lemon with the remaining oil for salsa verde.
Arrange the eggplant and haloumi and spoon over the salsa.

veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil, then add the carrot, celery and tomato paste and soften.
Add the lentils, soy sauce and tomatoes and simmer, stirring now and then.
Cook the spaghetti and toss through the sauce. Cover with plenty of parmesan.

veg.n: Action hero eggplant steak with onion rings
veg.make_ahead: Garlic butter up to 3 days ahead

steps.text: Mash the butter with the garlic and parsley.
Cut each eggplant lengthways into 2 thick steaks, score the flesh, brush with the olive oil and season with the salt.
Grill the eggplant over high heat until charred outside and soft right through.
Whisk the flour, baking powder and soda water into a batter.
Slice the onions into thick rings, dip in batter and fry in the vegetable oil at 180C until golden. Drain.
Top the eggplant steaks with the garlic butter and serve with the onion rings and rocket.
Chop the potatoes and slice the carrots, toss with 3 tbsp of the oil and the salt and roast at 200C for 20 minutes.
Toss the mushrooms and chickpeas with the honey, garlic, thyme and remaining oil.
Add to the tray and roast 20 minutes more, turning once.
Serve on one big tray.
Cut the potatoes into thin frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry in 140C oil until cooked but pale, drain and cool.
While the frites cool, season the mushrooms with salt.
Fry the frites again at 185C until crisp. Season with salt.
Sear the mushrooms in a heavy hot pan with the tablespoon of oil on both sides.
Lower the heat, add the butter and thyme and baste until tender, then lift out.

Add the peppercorns to the pan, then the brandy, carefully and away from the flame, and simmer briefly. Add the stock and soy sauce and reduce, then stir in the cream and simmer. Serve with the mushrooms and frites.
Cut the potatoes into thin frites, rinse and dry thoroughly.
Fry in 140C oil until cooked but pale, drain and cool.
While the frites cool, season the mushrooms with salt.
Fry the frites again at 185C until crisp. Season with salt.
Sear the mushrooms in a heavy hot pan with the tablespoon of oil on both sides.
Lower the heat, add the butter and thyme and baste until tender, then lift out.
Add the peppercorns to the pan, then the extra stock and vinegar, and simmer briefly. Add the stock and soy sauce and reduce, then stir in the cream and simmer. Serve with the mushrooms and frites.

veg.n: Pepperberry roast eggplant with sweet potato

steps.text: Cut the sweet potato into wedges, toss in half the oil and roast at 200C.
Halve the eggplants lengthways, score the flesh deeply and rub with the pepperberry, crushed garlic, salt and remaining oil.
Roast the eggplant cut side up alongside the wedges until soft and golden.
Warm the plum sauce.
Crumble the feta over the eggplant and serve with the wedges and plum sauce.

veg.n: Jersey City paneer and cauliflower biryani
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Toss the paneer and cauliflower with the yoghurt, garam masala and salt.
Rest in the fridge for 1 hour.
Slice the onions and fry in the oil until crisp, and soak the saffron in warm milk.
Par-cook the rice in boiling salted water.
Layer the paneer mixture, rice and onions in an ovenproof pot, drizzle with the saffron milk and seal tightly.
Bake at 170C.

veg.n: Prospector's sweet potato and bean chilli
veg.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, better the next day

steps.text: Dice the sweet potato, onion and garlic.
Soften the onion and garlic in the oil, then add the chopped chipotles and cumin.
Add the sweet potato, tomatoes, drained beans and water and simmer until thick and the sweet potato is tender.
Meanwhile bake the cornbread as the packet says.
Serve with sour cream and squares of cornbread.

veg.n: Scrooge's prize mushroom wellington with sage stuffing
veg.make_ahead: Wellington can be assembled up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cook the mushrooms in 20g of the butter until all the liquid is gone. Cool.
Fry the onion in 30g of the butter, then mix with the breadcrumbs, sage and 1 egg for the stuffing.
Overlap the pastry sheets, spread with the stuffing, spoon the mushrooms down the middle, roll up, seal and brush with the other egg, beaten.
Roast the chopped potatoes in the oil at 200C. After 10 minutes, add the wellington on a lined tray and bake 40 minutes until deep golden.
Meanwhile simmer the apples with the sugar and a splash of water until soft.
Rest the wellington. Melt the remaining butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce for a gravy.

veg.make_ahead: Onions up to 2 days, reheat gently

ingredients.item: brown onions, one halved and two sliced

steps.text: Heat the franks in barely simmering water with the halved onion for 3 minutes, then griddle until blistered.
Soften the sliced onions in the oil, then add the tomato paste, vinegar and a splash of water.
Steam the buns.
Fill with franks, mustard, sauerkraut and onions.
Slice the mushrooms, onions and capsicum thinly.
Fry the onion and capsicum in 1 tbsp of the oil on a hot plate until soft, then push aside.
Add the mushrooms and remaining oil and fry hard until browned and dry, then splash with the soy sauce and mix with the onion and capsicum.
Lay the provolone over the top to melt.
Scoop into the split bread rolls.

veg.make_ahead: Glaze up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Score the tofu blocks in a diamond pattern. Simmer the brown sugar, Dijon, orange juice and soy sauce into a glaze and brush it over.
Bake at 180C, basting often, until the glaze is sticky and deep golden.
Meanwhile boil the potatoes until tender, adding the beans for the last few minutes. Drain, cool and toss with the mayonnaise.
Rest the tofu for 5 minutes, then slice and serve with the potato salad.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Mash the lentils and mix with the breadcrumbs, egg, 50g of the parmesan and the salt, then roll into balls.
Brown the meatballs gently in the oil.
Add the tomatoes and torn basil and simmer gently.
Cook the rigatoni and toss through the sauce with the remaining parmesan.
Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Cut each cauliflower through the stem into 2 thick steaks and season with the flaky salt.
Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil with the paprika until dark and crisp.
Sear the cauliflower steaks in the remaining oil, then finish in the oven at 200C until tender.
Top the steaks with the garlic butter and load the potatoes with sour cream and the crisp mushrooms.
Brush the franks with the oil and griddle over medium-high heat until blistered and piping hot.
Steam the buns until warm.
Fill each bun with a frank, mustard and sauerkraut, then wrap in food-safe paper.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil with the paprika until crisp, then fry the haloumi until golden.
Toast the bread.
Layer the haloumi, mushrooms, lettuce and tomato with mayo across three slices per sandwich.
Pin with toothpicks, cut into triangles and serve with potato chips.
Dice the potatoes and fry in the oil with the chickpeas and paprika until crisp.
Scramble the eggs softly in the butter.
Warm the tortillas and fill with the eggs, potato and chickpeas, grated cheddar and salsa.
Roll tightly and toast seam side down in a dry pan.

veg.make_ahead: Make the day before

steps.text: Peel the celeriac, cut into thin slices, brush with the oil and roast at 200C until tender and lightly golden.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel.
Chill the celeriac and eggs.
Blitz the beans, miso, 1 tbsp of the capers, mayonnaise and lemon juice until smooth.
Lay the celeriac on a platter with the sliced eggs, cover with the sauce and scatter with the remaining capers.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

ingredients.item: large mushrooms, portobello and king oyster, halved

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Add the onions and thyme and soften, then stir in the tomato paste, soy sauce, stout and stock.
Return the mushrooms with the lentils, cover and braise at 160C until rich and thick.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter.
Serve the mushrooms on top of the mash.

ingredients.item: large mushrooms, portobello and king oyster, halved

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Add the onions and thyme and soften, then stir in the tomato paste, soy sauce, extra stock, balsamic vinegar, brown sugar and stock.
Return the mushrooms with the lentils, cover and braise at 160C until rich and thick.
Boil and mash the potatoes with plenty of butter.
Serve the mushrooms on top of the mash.
Spread the sourdough with the cranberry sauce.
Divide the smoked tofu, spinach and brie among four slices and close.
Butter the outsides.
Press in a hot sandwich pan or frying pan weighted with a second pan, turning once, until golden and the brie melts.
Cut each sandwich in half.
Toss the cauliflower with the paprika, brown sugar, crushed garlic, salt and 2 tbsp of the oil.
Cut the potatoes into fries and toss in the remaining oil.
Roast the cauliflower and fries at 220C on separate trays until the fries are crisp and the cauliflower is tender.
Brush the cauliflower with the barbecue sauce and roast 10 minutes more until sticky.
Pile the cauliflower over slices of white bread with the oven fries.
Roast the pumpkin at 200C until soft.
Stir the rice in the butter.
Add the hot stock a ladle at a time, stirring, until the rice is creamy.
Mash half the pumpkin through, fold in the rest with the parmesan.
Fry the sage leaves in the sage butter and spoon over.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

ingredients.item: large mushrooms, portobello and swiss brown, quartered
smoked tofu, cut into thin batons

steps.text: Peel the onions and potatoes and quarter the mushrooms.
Brown the mushrooms and smoked tofu in the oil in batches.
Brown the onions, stir in the tomato paste and flour, then add the wine, stock, thyme and mushrooms and tofu.
Simmer covered until the onions are tender and the sauce is glossy.
Boil and mash the potatoes with the butter.

ingredients.item: large mushrooms, portobello and swiss brown, quartered
smoked tofu, cut into thin batons

steps.text: Peel the onions and potatoes and quarter the mushrooms.
Brown the mushrooms and smoked tofu in the oil in batches.
Brown the onions, stir in the tomato paste and flour, then add the extra stock, grape juice, balsamic vinegar, stock, thyme and mushrooms and tofu.

veg.n: Funeral reception lentil and mushroom lasagne
veg.make_ahead: Assemble a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms and onion in the oil.
Add the lentils, tomatoes and red wine and simmer until thick.
Make a bechamel with the butter, flour and milk.
Layer the sauce, bechamel, lasagne sheets and mozzarella in a baking dish.
Bake at 180C.
Rest before cutting.

veg_af.n: Funeral reception lentil and mushroom lasagne
veg_af.make_ahead: Assemble a day ahead, bake fresh

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms and onion in the oil.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, stock and balsamic vinegar and simmer until thick.
Make a bechamel with the butter, flour and milk.
Layer the sauce, bechamel, lasagne sheets and mozzarella in a baking dish.
Bake at 180C.
Rest before cutting.
Cut the potatoes into chips, toss in the olive oil and roast at 220C.
Cut the haloumi into fingers and crumb in the flour, beaten egg and panko.
Shallow-fry the haloumi in the vegetable oil in batches until golden.
Cook the peas.
Serve with the tartare sauce.

veg.n: Elephant supper portobello with cherry sauce
veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

steps.text: Season the mushrooms with salt and pepper and sear gill side up in the oil over medium-high heat.
Turn, add the butter, baste and roast at 200C until tender.
Simmer the cherries with the wine and thyme until syrupy.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the mash butter until silky.
Slice the mushrooms and serve with the cherry sauce and mash.

veg_af.n: Elephant supper portobello with cherry sauce

steps.text: Season the mushrooms with salt and pepper and sear gill side up in the oil over medium-high heat.
Turn, add the butter, baste and roast at 200C until tender.
Simmer the cherries with the grape juice, water, balsamic vinegar and thyme until syrupy.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the mash butter until silky.
Slice the mushrooms and serve with the cherry sauce and mash.

veg.n: Red One's training day haloumi plate
veg.make_ahead: Chimichurri up to 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: large sweet potatoes, cut into wedges

steps.text: Toss the sweet potato with the vegetable oil, paprika and salt and roast at 220C.
Blitz the parsley, garlic, chilli, vinegar and olive oil into chimichurri.
Grill the haloumi over high heat for 2 minutes a side until charred.
Grill the broccolini.
Spoon the chimichurri over the haloumi and serve with the wedges and broccolini.

veg.n: Happy's apartment spaghetti with chickpea meatballs
veg.make_ahead: Meatballs and sauce up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Mash the chickpeas with the breadcrumbs, egg and half the parmesan and roll into balls, then brown gently in the oil.
Simmer in the tomatoes with half the garlic, crushed.
Cook the spaghetti and toss with the sauce and the rest of the parmesan.
Split the baguette, spread with the butter mixed with the remaining crushed garlic, and bake at 200C.

veg.make_ahead: Soak beans overnight

steps.text: Soak the beans overnight and drain.
Fry the smoked tofu in 1 tbsp of the oil until crisp and set aside.
Soften the onion and garlic in the remaining oil with the paprika.
Add the beans, tomatoes, rosemary and stock to cover, and simmer until the beans are soft and the stew is thick.
Stir the smoked tofu back in and serve with the bread.

veg.n: London tournament mushroom and ale pie
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Slice the onions and brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Add the onions and soften, then stir in the flour, ale, stock and soy sauce and simmer until thick.
Spoon into a pie dish, cool for 10 minutes and top with the pastry brushed with beaten egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Meanwhile boil and mash the potatoes with the butter, and cook the peas.

veg_af.n: London tournament mushroom and ale pie

steps.text: Slice the onions and brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil.
Add the onions and soften, then stir in the flour, extra stock, malt vinegar, water, stock and soy sauce and simmer until thick.
Spoon into a pie dish, cool for 10 minutes and top with the pastry brushed with beaten egg.
Bake at 200C until puffed and golden.
Meanwhile boil and mash the potatoes with the butter, and cook the peas.
Scrub the celeriac, trim the root and rub with 20g of the butter, softened, and the herbs.
Wrap loosely in foil and roast at 180C, then unwrap for the last 20 minutes until golden and tender to a skewer.
Mix the breadcrumbs with the onion, chopped sage and the remaining butter, melted, and bake the stuffing alongside for the last 25 minutes.
Toss the potatoes in the oil and roast on another tray.
Rest the celeriac for 10 minutes, cut into wedges and serve with the stuffing, cranberry sauce and potatoes.
